title: When A.I. Comes for Your Purpose in Life

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

I use a different starting word every day.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: This morning, one of the hardest problems in mathematics may have just been solved, not by a human, but by artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，数学界最棘手的难题之一可能刚刚被解决了，不是由人类，而是由人工智能。

sentences.en: So many people are freaked out about AI taking their jobs and now you can add mathematicians to that liSt.
sentences.zh: 很多人都对人工智能抢走他们的工作感到恐慌，现在你可以把数学家也加进那个名单了。

sentences.en: In the span of just a few months,
sentences.zh: 在短短几个月的时间里，

sentences.en: AI systems have tackled some of the biggest problems in math.
sentences.zh: 人工智能系统已经攻克了一些数学领域最大的难题。

sentences.en: And they've solved them.
sentences.zh: 而且它们把这些问题解决了。

sentences.en: For decades, mathematicians have been working to solve this problem.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，数学家们一直致力于解决这个问题。

sentences.en: They haven't been able to crack it.
sentences.zh: 他们一直没能攻克它。

sentences.en: But AI, it just did it easily.
sentences.zh: 但人工智能，它轻而易举地做到了。

sentences.en: Last month, it was one of the field's so-called millennium probleMs.
sentences.zh: 上个月，它解决了该领域所谓的“千禧年难题”之一。

sentences.en: And then last week, OpenAI released a torrent of over 350 other results, covering virtually every corner of mathematics.
sentences.zh: 然后上周，OpenAI发布了一连串超过350个其他成果，几乎涵盖了数学的每一个角落。

sentences.en: These are problems that literally the smartest humans on Earth have been working on for decades and sometimes even centuries.
sentences.zh: 这些问题是地球上最聪明的人类几十年来，甚至几个世纪以来一直在研究的。

sentences.en: This AI takeover of the field has raised some uncomfortable questions and unleashed a range of emotions.
sentences.zh: 这种人工智能对该领域的接管引发了一些令人不安的问题，并释放了一系列情绪。

sentences.en: And so today, we speak with a mathematician, Cornell math professor Stephen Strogatz, about what happens when AI doesn't just come for your job, but for your purpose.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我们采访了一位数学家，康奈尔大学数学教授斯蒂芬·斯特罗加茨，探讨当人工智能不仅要抢走你的工作，还要抢走你的目标时，会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月13日，星期二。

sentences.en: Steve Strogatz, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·斯特罗加茨，非常感谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: Hi, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 你好，瑞秋。

sentences.en: I'm really happy to see you and be here with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你，也很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: So, Steve, one of the reasons we're talking to you is, of course, because you are an esteemed professor at Cornell.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，我们采访你的原因之一，当然是因为你是康奈尔大学受人尊敬的教授。

sentences.en: But we are really talking to you because you are known for translating math into English for those of us who do not speak math.
sentences.zh: 但我们真正采访你是因为你以擅长为我们这些不懂数学的人将数学翻译成英语而闻名。

sentences.en: And you actually have a book that gets at this very thing.
sentences.zh: 你甚至有一本书就是专门讲这个的。

sentences.en: It is called Big Math.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《大数学》。

sentences.en: And so we are turning to you to help sort of translate this destabilizing moment in math that you and your colleagues are living through.
sentences.zh: 所以我们向你求助，希望能帮忙解读一下你和你的同事们正在经历的这个让数学界动荡不安的时刻。

sentences.en: Can you just start by explaining to us, how would you sum up the mood in math right now?
sentences.zh: 你能先为我们解释一下，你如何总结现在数学界的氛围吗？

sentences.en: Ooh, the mood.
sentences.zh: 噢，氛围啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, the mood.
sentences.zh: 对，氛围。

sentences.en: The mood is discombobulated.
sentences.zh: 氛围是混乱不堪的。

sentences.en: We're all a swirl.
sentences.zh: 我们都感到心乱如麻。

sentences.en: We're spinning.
sentences.zh: 我们晕头转向。

sentences.en: Some people are exhilarated.
sentences.zh: 有些人感到兴奋不已。

sentences.en: They see a great golden age upon us with the help of our computer friends.
sentences.zh: 他们认为在计算机朋友的帮助下，一个伟大的黄金时代即将来临。

sentences.en: Most people, I think, are feeling grief.
sentences.zh: 但我认为大多数人感到的是悲伤。

sentences.en: And we're in different stages.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于不同的阶段。

sentences.en: Some people are bargaining.
sentences.zh: 有些人还在讨价还价。

sentences.en: Some are accepting.
sentences.zh: 有些人已经接受了。

sentences.en: Some are still denying.
sentences.zh: 有些人还在否认。

sentences.en: What stage of grief are you in?
sentences.zh: 你处于悲伤的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: Today, I'm feeling pretty good.
sentences.zh: 今天，我感觉还不错。

sentences.en: I have been dark.
sentences.zh: 我曾经陷入过黑暗。

sentences.en: There have been days when I actually cried during interviews.
sentences.zh: 有些日子里，我在采访中甚至哭了出来。

sentences.en: You know what's actually being lost is we like to think of ourselves as heroes, and maybe that's over.
sentences.zh: 你知道，真正失去的是我们喜欢把自己视为英雄，也许那种日子结束了。

sentences.en: That's the big news.
sentences.zh: 这就是大新闻。

sentences.en: It's hard to be a hero if you can't be the first to solve a problem or to understand something or to explain it to the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你不能成为第一个解决问题、理解事物或向世界解释它的人，就很难成为英雄。

sentences.en: And for the thousands of years that our culture of math has existed, some of us did fantasize about being heroes in our own story.
sentences.zh: 在我们数学文化存在的几千年里，我们中的一些人确实幻想过成为自己故事里的英雄。

sentences.en: And now that's over.
sentences.zh: 现在这一切都结束了。

sentences.en: At least, I mean, this is the grief version of myself talking.
sentences.zh: 至少，我是说，这是悲伤版本的我在说话。

sentences.en: I can, of course, like any professor, argue against myself.
sentences.zh: 当然，像任何教授一样，我可以反驳我自己。

sentences.en: But in the sad version, we won't get to be heroes anymore.
sentences.zh: 但在悲伤的版本里，我们再也无法成为英雄了。

sentences.en: I want to get into this, Steve,
sentences.zh: 我想深入探讨一下这一点，史蒂夫，

sentences.en: because I feel like a lot of people listening aren't going to quite understand what you mean by heroes and what you mean by solving problems that nobody's ever solved before.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得很多听众可能不太理解你所说的“英雄”是什么意思，也不太理解你所说的“解决前人从未解决的问题”是什么意思。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Like when I think of, for example, a math college professor teaching students, I'm thinking of that scene in Good Will Hunting.
sentences.zh: 比如当我想到大学数学教授教学生时，我会想到《心灵捕手》里的那个场景。

sentences.en: I also put an advanced Fourier system on the main hallway chalkboard.
sentences.zh: 我也在主走廊的黑板上写了一个高级傅里叶系统。

sentences.en: And I'm hoping that one of you might prove it by the end of the semester.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们中有人能在学期结束前证明它。

sentences.en: Where Matt Damon's character is solving a very long, complicated math problem on a chalkboard.
sentences.zh: 马特·达蒙饰演的角色在黑板上解一道非常长、非常复杂的数学题。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: What do you do?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么？

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: That's people's work.
sentences.zh: 那是别人的工作。

sentences.en: You can't graffiti here.
sentences.zh: 你不能在这里乱涂乱画。

sentences.en: Am I Matt Damon in this version of the story?
sentences.zh: 在这个故事版本里，我是马特·达蒙吗？

sentences.en: You're either Matt Damon or you're the guy that finds Matt Damon's proof and thinks, my God, this guy is a genius and he just needs a little bit of support.
sentences.zh: 你要么是马特·达蒙，要么是那个发现马特·达蒙证明过程的人，心想：天哪，这家伙是个天才，他只需要一点点支持。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Looks right.
sentences.zh: 看起来是对的。

sentences.en: I'm probably that guy.
sentences.zh: 我大概是那个人。

sentences.en: Okay, so is it, I'm sure that your days are more complicated than this movie scene.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我相信你的日子比电影里的场景要复杂得多。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to get a sense of, like, are you helping people solve what lay people might think of as complicated puzzles?
sentences.zh: 我只是想了解一下，你是在帮助人们解决外行可能认为的复杂谜题吗？

sentences.en: That's a good word for it, yes.
sentences.zh: 这个词用得好，是的。

sentences.en: Our world is about puzzles.
sentences.zh: 我们的世界就是关于谜题的。

sentences.en: It's puzzles that we create.
sentences.zh: 是我们自己创造的谜题。

sentences.en: Depending on which type of math we're doing.
sentences.zh: 取决于我们正在做哪种数学。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's puzzles that nature hands to us.
sentences.zh: 有时是大自然交给我们的谜题。

sentences.en: That's the kind of math I do, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实就是我做的数学类型。

sentences.en: Wait, tell us what you mean by that.
sentences.zh: 等等，告诉我们你这话是什么意思。

sentences.en: That's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 那真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Well, here's something I've personally been fascinated with, which is how do groups get organized?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我个人一直对一件事很着迷，那就是群体是如何组织起来的？

sentences.en: Could be groups of people, could be groups of crickets.
sentences.zh: 可以是人群，也可以是蟋蟀群。

sentences.en: I mean, that's one thing I might be known for.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那可能是我出名的原因之一。

sentences.en: We have crickets here in Ithaca, a species called the snowy tree cricket.
sentences.zh: 我们在伊萨卡这里有蟋蟀，一种叫雪树蟋的物种。

sentences.en: They chirp in enormous choruses, all chirping in unison, in sync.
sentences.zh: 它们在巨大的合唱中鸣叫，全部整齐划一，同步鸣叫。

sentences.en: And normally, like, if you see people, say, in a symphony, all the musicians playing in perfect time, they're very highly trained, expert musicians.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，如果你看到人们，比如在交响乐团里，所有的音乐家都以完美的节奏演奏，他们是非常训练有素的专家。

sentences.en: But yet these crickets can do it, too.
sentences.zh: 但这些蟋蟀也能做到这一点。

sentences.en: How do they chirp in unison?
sentences.zh: 它们是如何做到整齐划一地鸣叫的？

sentences.en: And we now know the answer, that when one cricket hears the chirp of another,
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道了答案，当一只蟋蟀听到另一只蟋蟀的鸣叫时，

sentences.en: it actually makes a little adjustment into its nervous system that changes the timing of its next chirp.
sentences.zh: 它实际上会对自己的神经系统进行微调，从而改变下一次鸣叫的时间。

sentences.en: And we can measure that.
sentences.zh: 我们可以测量那个过程。

sentences.en: So now the math problem is, suppose I have a thousand of them in a field, how does that collective get itself so that all thousand are chirping in unison?
sentences.zh: 所以现在的数学问题是，假设我在田野里有一千只蟋蟀，这个群体是如何做到让那一千只蟋蟀整齐划一地鸣叫的？

sentences.en: And you might say, I don't care about crickets, but your heart also has things that go in unison.
sentences.zh: 你可能会说，我不关心蟋蟀，但你的心脏也有整齐划一的东西。

sentences.en: You have special cells that trigger the rest of your heart to beat and pump blood to your body and to your brain.
sentences.zh: 你有特殊的细胞触发心脏的其他部分跳动，并将血液泵送到你的身体和大脑。

sentences.en: And if those 10,000 cells are not organized to all zap in unison, telling your ventricles to pump, you're going to be very sick.
sentences.zh: 如果那10,000个细胞没有组织起来同步放电，指挥你的心室泵血，你就会病得很重。

sentences.en: So what I'm saying is, to a mathematician, these are the same problem.
sentences.zh: 所以我想说的是，对数学家来说，这些是同一个问题。

sentences.en: This is variations on a theme.
sentences.zh: 这是同一主题的变奏。

sentences.en: And what we try to do is abstract the messy real world into a very beautiful, pristine mathematical world where we can figure out how can we encourage synchrony?
sentences.zh: 我们试图做的是将混乱的现实世界抽象为一个非常美丽、原始的数学世界，在那里我们可以找出如何鼓励同步？

sentences.en: How can we discourage it?
sentences.zh: 我们如何阻止它？

sentences.en: There are cases where it's bad, like people who have Parkinson's disease or epilepsy.
sentences.zh: 有些情况下同步是不好的，比如患有帕金森病或癫痫的人。

sentences.en: Their brain cells are firing in sync when they shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 他们的脑细胞在不该同步的时候同步放电了。

sentences.en: This is a math problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个数学问题。

sentences.en: So just to summarize, Steve, what you're saying is that understanding a thousand crickets and why they move and make the noise that they do,
sentences.zh: 所以总结一下，史蒂夫，你的意思是理解一千只蟋蟀以及它们为什么移动并发出那种声音，

sentences.en: that might not be of great interest or importance to many people.
sentences.zh: 这对很多人来说可能没有太大的兴趣或重要性。

sentences.en: However, understanding that can help you understand how the heart works, for example.
sentences.zh: 然而，理解这一点可以帮助你理解心脏是如何工作的，例如。

sentences.en: And so it might not matter to me how a cricket makes its noise, although I am actually interested in that, listening to you explain it.
sentences.zh: 所以蟋蟀如何发出声音对我来说可能并不重要，尽管听你解释后我确实对此很感兴趣。

sentences.en: But it should matter to me because the downstream effects of that, the medical implications, that matters to me.
sentences.zh: 但它应该对我重要，因为它的下游影响，即医学意义，那对我来说很重要。

sentences.en: That's the argument.
sentences.zh: 这就是论点。

sentences.en: This is a spooky aspect of history, that if you let people follow their curiosity, great things can happen, but it might take centuries.
sentences.zh: 这是历史中令人毛骨悚然的一面，如果你让人们追随他们的好奇心，伟大的事情可能会发生，但这可能需要几个世纪。

sentences.en: I feel like what I'm getting from what you're describing is the sense that you are a person who doesn't just care about math because it's good for your job or to get to an end result.
sentences.zh: 我觉得从你的描述中我感受到，你是一个不仅因为数学对工作有益或能达到最终结果而关心数学的人。

sentences.en: I'm getting the sense from you that you care about understanding math because you are curious about the world around you.
sentences.zh: 我从你身上感受到，你关心理解数学是因为你对周围的世界充满好奇。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could just talk a little bit about how people feel about themselves in the math field and the feelings they get from actually solving some of these puzzles.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否能谈谈数学领域的人们是如何看待自己的，以及他们从真正解决这些谜题中获得的感受。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's good to go here.
sentences.zh: 是的，谈这个很好。

sentences.en: This question of feeling is what's at stake, among other things.
sentences.zh: 这种感受的问题，除其他事项外，正是利害攸关之处。

sentences.en: You mentioned puzzles.
sentences.zh: 你提到了谜题。

sentences.en: Think about what it is to do whatever your favorite puzzle is, jigsaw, sudoku, crossword puzzle.
sentences.zh: 想想做你最喜欢的谜题是什么感觉，拼图、数独、填字游戏。

sentences.en: It sort of feels good to be stumped, and then it's satisfying when you have a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 被难住的感觉很好，当你取得突破时，那种满足感很棒。

sentences.en: When you finally get the word of the crossword, yes.
sentences.zh: 当你终于填出填字游戏的那个词时，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, isn't that good?
sentences.zh: 是啊，那感觉不是很棒吗？

sentences.en: Everything clicks into place.
sentences.zh: 一切都各就各位了。

sentences.en: People like that feeling, and a lot of us live for that.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢那种感觉，我们很多人为此而活。

sentences.en: We want that.
sentences.zh: 我们想要那个。

sentences.en: It's like an addiction.
sentences.zh: 这就像一种瘾。

sentences.en: We want that feeling over and over.
sentences.zh: 我们一次又一次地想要那种感觉。

sentences.en: So we're in the business of pleasuring ourselves that way.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从事的就是以那种方式取悦自己的行业。

sentences.en: Now—
sentences.zh: 现在——

sentences.en: Can I ask you to describe that slightly differently?
sentences.zh: 我能请你换一种方式描述吗？

sentences.en: I wanted to say it that way because I actually think it is sexual, slightly.
sentences.zh: 我想那样说是因为我实际上认为它有点性意味。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Because think of it abstractly, if I don't want to be too risque here.
sentences.zh: 因为抽象地想一想，如果我不想在这里说得太露骨的话。

sentences.en: But what's going on is there's a queSt.
sentences.zh: 但正在发生的是一场探索。

sentences.en: In our case, we want answers.
sentences.zh: 在我们的案例中，我们想要答案。

sentences.en: We want solutions, and we want understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们想要解决方案，我们想要理解。

sentences.en: We want aha moments.
sentences.zh: 我们想要“啊哈”时刻。

sentences.en: And so the fact that the problems resist and have to be seduced into yielding their secrets, it's kind of sexy.
sentences.zh: 所以，问题本身具有抗拒性，必须被诱导才能交出它们的秘密，这有点性感。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Why are you resistant to that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么对此感到抗拒？

sentences.en: I'm not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: I'm just thinking about how many 17, 18-year-olds are hearing this and are suddenly going to sign up to be math makers.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想有多少17、18岁的年轻人听到这些，会突然报名成为数学创造者。

sentences.en: They should.
sentences.zh: 他们应该报名。

sentences.en: You've recruited an entire generation of mathematicians.
sentences.zh: 你已经招募了一整代数学家。

sentences.en: No, this interview took a bit of a turn, but I think a lot of people could appreciate and relate to the idea of the satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 不，这次采访出现了一些转折，但我认为很多人都能理解并共鸣于那种满足感。

sentences.en: I hope that you will keep this part of it because this is real.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能保留这一部分，因为这是真实的。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not the mathematician, Steve, so you are the expert.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是数学家，史蒂夫，所以你是专家。

sentences.en: I'm going to defer to you about the pleasure you people get from math, but I just want to really underscore that to a lot of people, this is not just a job.
sentences.zh: 关于你们从数学中获得的乐趣，我打算听你的，但我真的想强调，对很多人来说，这不仅仅是一份工作。

sentences.en: That for some people, this is a passion that goes beyond a career.
sentences.zh: 对某些人而言，这是一种超越职业的热情。

sentences.en: And so this kind of gets me to my next point,
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了下一个观点，

sentences.en: which is I want to talk about this kind of dawning realization that you and other people in your field have had about how disruptive AI could be.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈你和你领域里的其他人对于人工智能可能具有多大破坏性所产生的那种觉醒般的认识。

sentences.en: And I want to go back and have you explain to me and to our audience what your initial perception of AI was.
sentences.zh: 我想回过头来，请你向我和我们的听众解释一下你最初对人工智能的看法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, at first we were laughing at AI.
sentences.zh: 你知道，起初我们是在嘲笑人工智能。

sentences.en: You may remember when it first came out, it was hallucinating all the time, couldn't be trusted.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得它刚出来的时候，它总是胡言乱语，根本不可信。

sentences.en: There was a joke going around, and it was real.
sentences.zh: 当时流传着一个笑话，而且是真的。

sentences.en: It couldn't count the number of ours in strawberry.
sentences.zh: 它数不清草莓里有几个“r”。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But that was like 2022.
sentences.zh: 但那是在2022年左右。

sentences.en: As the years went by, AI got better at math very faSt.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，人工智能在数学方面进步得非常快。

sentences.en: It soon was as good as a good high school student, then it was a good college student.
sentences.zh: 它很快就达到了优秀高中生的水平，然后是优秀的大学生。

sentences.en: Then in March of this year, it started to be at the level of a very good graduate student,
sentences.zh: 到了今年三月，它开始达到非常优秀的硕士生的水平，

sentences.en: which is a measure that means something to us as math professors because we deal with grad students all day long.
sentences.zh: 这对我们数学教授来说是一个有意义的衡量标准，因为我们整天都在和研究生打交道。

sentences.en: Can you just explain what you started seeing that made your perception change?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下你看到了什么，从而改变了你的看法吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So this gets into the word that's everywhere nowadays, benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这就要提到如今随处可见的一个词：基准测试。

sentences.en: We give them tasks, and we see can they solve a problem.
sentences.zh: 我们给它们任务，看看它们能否解决问题。

sentences.en: And how do they solve it?
sentences.zh: 它们又是如何解决的呢？

sentences.en: Do they solve it with style?
sentences.zh: 它们解决得有风格吗？

sentences.en: I guess I keep coming up with adjectives that will surprise you besides our sexy, passionate nature.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直在想出一些会让你惊讶的形容词，除了我们那种性感、热情的本质之外。

sentences.en: We're also very interested in style.
sentences.zh: 我们也对风格非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: We want to be elegant.
sentences.zh: 我们想要优雅。

sentences.en: The highest compliment you could give to another mathematician is, oh, what an elegant proof.
sentences.zh: 你能给另一位数学家的最高赞美就是：哦，多么优雅的证明。

sentences.en: What does elegant mean for us?
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，优雅意味着什么？

sentences.en: Elegant for us is something that has a surprise value but is also inevitable once you see it.
sentences.zh: 对我们而言，优雅是指某种既有惊喜感，又在看到它后觉得不可避免的东西。

sentences.en: It's a head-slapping thing like, that is so perfect.
sentences.zh: 这是一种让人拍案叫绝的东西，就像是：太完美了。

sentences.en: That's such a great argument.
sentences.zh: 那真是个绝妙的论证。

sentences.en: Why didn't I think of that?
sentences.zh: 我怎么没想到呢？

sentences.en: So for a long time, the AIs, the computers, were not producing elegant math.
sentences.zh: 所以很长一段时间以来，人工智能和计算机并没有产生优雅的数学。

sentences.en: They behaved like machines.
sentences.zh: 它们的表现就像机器一样。

sentences.en: They would get the job done but with no panache, no flair.
sentences.zh: 它们能完成工作，但没有风度，没有格调。

sentences.en: But by May of this year, everybody sat up straight when an AI solved a problem that the world's best mathematicians were interested in.
sentences.zh: 但到了今年五月，当人工智能解决了一个世界顶尖数学家们都感兴趣的问题时，所有人都坐直了身子。

sentences.en: And it did it with flair.
sentences.zh: 而且它做得很有格调。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So take us to May, Steve.
sentences.zh: 那么带我们回到五月吧，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: What did you see exactly?
sentences.zh: 你到底看到了什么？

sentences.en: And how did it start changing your perception about what the models could do?
sentences.zh: 它又是如何开始改变你对这些模型能力的看法的？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, it solved a problem that a very charming old mathematician had posed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，它解决了一个非常迷人的老数学家提出的问题。

sentences.en: Because it's part of the culture.
sentences.zh: 因为这是文化的一部分。

sentences.en: I have to tell you why this problem is a beloved problem.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你为什么这个问题是一个备受喜爱的问题。

sentences.en: Tell me.
sentences.zh: 告诉我。

sentences.en: This is a puzzle associated with a mathematician named Paul Erdős, a Hungarian-American mathematician who was completely, ridiculously unable to function in the real world.
sentences.zh: 这是一个与数学家保罗·埃尔德什（Paul Erdős）有关的谜题，他是一位匈牙利裔美国数学家，在现实生活中完全、荒谬地无法自理。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: He didn't really have a home.
sentences.zh: 他基本上没有家。

sentences.en: He would show up at your door, meaning you're any mathematician around the world.
sentences.zh: 他会出现在你的门口，意思是世界各地的任何数学家。

sentences.en: He had a beaten up old suitcase and he would show up and say, my brain is open, which means I'm ready to work with you on a math problem.
sentences.zh: 他带着一个破旧的旧手提箱出现，然后说：“我的大脑是开放的”，这意味着我准备好和你一起研究数学问题了。

sentences.en: And that meant you had to take him into your house and take care of him because he couldn't make toaSt.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你必须把他接到家里照顾他，因为他连烤面包都不会。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I'm really starting to get the sense that mathematicians are real characters, Steve.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，我真的开始感觉到数学家们都是些有个性的人了。

sentences.en: He was also a methamphetamine junkie.
sentences.zh: 他还是个甲基苯丙胺瘾君子。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: This guy would take so many drugs because he was hyped up all the time wanting to do math.
sentences.zh: 这家伙会服用很多药物，因为他总是处于亢奋状态，想要做数学题。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Now, why would anyone put up with him?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么有人会忍受他呢？

sentences.en: He was extremely brilliant.
sentences.zh: 他极其聪明。

sentences.en: And he would come up with these really good questions, which it turns out is not so easy to do.
sentences.zh: 他会提出这些非常好的问题，事实证明这并不容易做到。

sentences.en: So he was a really good puzzle poser.
sentences.zh: 所以他是一个非常好的谜题提出者。

sentences.en: And he also left the legacy on the order of a thousand great puzzles that we still don't know how to solve.
sentences.zh: 他还留下了大约一千个伟大的谜题作为遗产，我们至今仍不知道如何解决。

sentences.en: I want to say one last thing about him.
sentences.zh: 关于他，我想最后再说一件事。

sentences.en: So he was constantly winning money because he was so good at math that people would give him prize money for various things.
sentences.zh: 他经常赢得奖金，因为他数学太好了，人们会因为各种事情给他奖金。

sentences.en: And he would always give the money away to young people, including a person who today is considered maybe the greatest living mathematician, Terry Tao.
sentences.zh: 他总是把钱送给年轻人，包括今天被认为是当今最伟大的数学家之一的陶哲轩（Terry Tao）。

sentences.en: And so there's a picture of little Terry Tao, who is often called the Mozart of math because he was a child prodigy.
sentences.zh: 所以有一张小陶哲轩的照片，他常被称为数学界的莫扎特，因为他是个神童。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm getting a little verklempt here, like they say on Saturday Night Live.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我有点激动了，就像《周六夜现场》里说的那样。

sentences.en: No, it's something you care about.
sentences.zh: 不，这是你在乎的事情。

sentences.en: Because it's so sweet, this generational passing.
sentences.zh: 因为这种代际传承太温馨了。

sentences.en: You see the picture of old man Erdisch with his gray hair.
sentences.zh: 你看到那张留着灰白头发的老人埃尔德什的照片。

sentences.en: The two of them are sitting together with their paper and pencil.
sentences.zh: 他们俩坐在一起，拿着纸和笔。

sentences.en: Such nerds with very serious faces.
sentences.zh: 真是些表情严肃的书呆子。

sentences.en: Terry Tao is like eight years old.
sentences.zh: 陶哲轩当时大概八岁。

sentences.en: Two great mathematicians working together, happy as clams, on some real-world inconsequential problem for the pleasure of being together.
sentences.zh: 两位伟大的数学家坐在一起，像蛤蜊一样快乐，研究着某个现实中无关紧要的问题，只为了在一起的乐趣。

sentences.en: So my point was that Erdisch was a sweet man, in addition to being a junkie and a genius.
sentences.zh: 所以我的意思是，埃尔德什除了是个瘾君子和天才之外，还是个可爱的人。

sentences.en: Not mutually exclusive.
sentences.zh: 这并不相互排斥。

sentences.en: Not all exclusive.
sentences.zh: 并不完全排斥。

sentences.en: Okay, so the fact that Erdisch left us these beautiful problems and a f***ing machine, you could bleep me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，埃尔德什留给我们的这些美丽的难题，以及一台该死的机器——你可以把我消音。

sentences.en: It solved the unit distance conjecture of Erdisch.
sentences.zh: 它解决了埃尔德什的单位距离猜想。

sentences.en: Okay, wait, wait, wait, we have to translate this into English.
sentences.zh: 好的，等等，等等，我们得把它翻译成英语。

sentences.en: So in May, one of the puzzles created by this man Erdisch that people have spent a lot of time trying to solve and is a passion, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 所以五月份，这个叫埃尔德什的人创造的谜题之一，人们花了很多时间试图解决，听起来这是一种热情。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: What happens to it?
sentences.zh: 它怎么了？

sentences.en: It's solved by AI?
sentences.zh: 被人工智能解决了？

sentences.en: Is that what you're telling us?
sentences.zh: 这就是你要告诉我们的吗？

sentences.en: It's solved by AI.
sentences.zh: 被人工智能解决了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Open AI, somebody in there sets their machine to working on one of these great Erdisch problems, and it solves it in a way that is very beautiful.
sentences.zh: OpenAI，里面有人让他们的机器去研究这些伟大的埃尔德什问题之一，它以一种非常美丽的方式解决了它。

sentences.en: Elegant.
sentences.zh: 优雅。

sentences.en: Absolutely elegant, very imaginative, an aesthetic high point.
sentences.zh: 绝对优雅，非常有想象力，是一个审美的高点。

sentences.en: All of us are agog because this is so clever, and we can learn from it.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都惊呆了，因为这太聪明了，我们可以从中学习。

sentences.en: This is important.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: It's not opaque.
sentences.zh: 它不是不透明的。

sentences.en: We can follow what it did.
sentences.zh: 我们可以追踪它所做的事情。

sentences.en: It took a certain part of math.
sentences.zh: 它采用了数学的某一部分。

sentences.en: You don't need to know what I mean by this, but it's called discrete geometry.
sentences.zh: 你不需要知道我指的这个词是什么，但它叫离散几何。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then it took a different part of math called number theory,
sentences.zh: 然后它采用了数学的另一部分，叫数论，

sentences.en: two parts that hadn't talked to each other much in the past and found that if you put them in conversation with each other, that was like the magic key.
sentences.zh: 这两个部分过去很少交流，它发现如果让它们对话，那就是一把神奇的钥匙。

sentences.en: No one thought of making that connection before.
sentences.zh: 以前没人想过建立这种联系。

sentences.en: It was the key to the problem.
sentences.zh: 这是解决问题的关键。

sentences.en: So objectively, what it did was really beautiful and brilliant, but it wasn't human.
sentences.zh: 所以客观地说，它所做的事情确实美丽而辉煌，但它不是人类。

sentences.en: Now, it stole, some people would say, it stole from us because it learned from thousands of years of human ingenuity.
sentences.zh: 现在，它窃取了——有些人会说，它窃取了我们的东西，因为它学习了人类几千年的智慧。

sentences.en: It built from other people's work.
sentences.zh: 它是建立在别人的工作基础上的。

sentences.en: It read every book.
sentences.zh: 它读了每一本书。

sentences.en: It read every math paper.
sentences.zh: 它读了每一篇数学论文。

sentences.en: It has knowledge like no human mathematician has ever had.
sentences.zh: 它拥有的知识是任何人类数学家从未拥有过的。

sentences.en: So it's a totally alien kind of intelligence that we have created that's now teaching us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们创造了一种完全异类的智能，现在它正在教导我们。

sentences.en: That's what happened in May.
sentences.zh: 这就是五月份发生的事情。

sentences.en: That was just May.
sentences.zh: 那仅仅是五月。

sentences.en: This is October.
sentences.zh: 现在是十月。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个关于设计之爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代在夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍贵的财产去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky）。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: I want to get back to the story of this dawning realization in your world, Steve, about AI.
sentences.zh: 我想回到你那个领域里关于人工智能觉醒般认识的故事，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: So you have this big aha moment in May.
sentences.zh: 所以你在五月份有了这个巨大的顿悟时刻。

sentences.en: We are now, as we speak, in the month of October.
sentences.zh: 我们现在说话的时候，正处于十月份。

sentences.en: Last month, OpenAI announced that it had solved this huge math problem, this millennium problem.
sentences.zh: 上个月，OpenAI宣布它解决了这个巨大的数学难题，这个千禧年难题。

sentences.en: And it made all kinds of news that had broken outside of the math community.
sentences.zh: 它在数学界之外引起了各种新闻报道。

sentences.en: It got to lay people like me, for instance.
sentences.zh: 它传到了像我这样的外行耳中。

sentences.en: And I want to just explain, first of all, to our listeners, what is the millennium problem?
sentences.zh: 我想先向我们的听众解释一下，什么是千禧年难题？

sentences.en: And why did this feel like a watershed moment?
sentences.zh: 为什么这感觉像是一个分水岭时刻？

sentences.en: So there are seven of these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 总共有七个这样的问题。

sentences.en: They were all formalized to commemorate the new century.
sentences.zh: 它们都是为了纪念新世纪而正式提出的。

sentences.en: That's why they're the millennium probleMs.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它们被称为千禧年难题。

sentences.en: In the year 2000, some of the world's finest mathematicians got together to take stock.
sentences.zh: 在2000年，一些世界上最优秀的数学家聚在一起进行盘点。

sentences.en: Like, where are we in our field?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们在领域里处于什么位置？

sentences.en: And what are seven great mountains that we would like to climb?
sentences.zh: 我们想要攀登的七座大山是什么？

sentences.en: These are problems created for the sake of solving them, like what you were talking about earlier.
sentences.zh: 这些问题是为了解决它们而创造的，就像你刚才谈到的那样。

sentences.en: These are problems made for the satisfaction of solving them.
sentences.zh: 这些问题是为了解决它们所带来的满足感而制作的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're aspirational puzzles.
sentences.zh: 它们是令人向往的谜题。

sentences.en: So these were our big dreams, seven of them, in seven different parts of math.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的七大梦想，分别属于数学的七个不同领域。

sentences.en: So one of the seven millennium problems was already solved a few years back by a really crazy Russian mathematician who didn't like to cut his fingernails so that they got very
sentences.zh: 七大千禧年难题中，有一个几年前已经被解决了，是一位非常古怪的俄罗斯数学家，他不喜欢剪指甲，所以指甲长得非常

sentences.en: long.
sentences.zh: 长。

sentences.en: Like, imagine if you never cut your fingernails ever.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，如果你从来不剪指甲会怎样。

sentences.en: I don't want to make all mathematicians sound crazy or drug addicts or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我不是想把所有数学家都描述成疯子、瘾君子之类的。

sentences.en: I'm just giving you the truth here.
sentences.zh: 我只是在陈述事实。

sentences.en: You're going to have to list some other ones then.
sentences.zh: 那你得列举一些其他的例子了。

sentences.en: But OK, I'm just OK.
sentences.zh: 不过好吧，我只是……好吧。

sentences.en: OK, one of them was solved already.
sentences.zh: 好吧，其中一个确实已经被解决了。

sentences.en: There were six remaining.
sentences.zh: 还剩下六个。

sentences.en: By September, rumor started to leak out that one of the AI companies was on the verge of solving one of the last six millennium probleMs.
sentences.zh: 到了九月，有传言称某家人工智能公司即将攻克最后六个千禧年难题中的一个。

sentences.en: And the rumor was that it was the one called the Navier-Stokes millennium problem.
sentences.zh: 传言说那个难题叫纳维-斯托克斯问题。

sentences.en: And what was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's about water and air and how they flow.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它是关于水和空气以及它们如何流动的。

sentences.en: And the equations we use to describe the flow of anything that can flow, honey, lava, blood, that's governed by these equations, the Navier-Stokes equations.
sentences.zh: 我们用来描述任何流体流动——比如蜂蜜、熔岩、血液——的方程，就是纳维-斯托克斯方程。

sentences.en: And it was to show that the Navier-Stokes equations could break down is what the problem was, show that the Navier-Stokes equations have a fatal flaw.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的核心是证明纳维-斯托克斯方程可能会失效，证明它们存在致命缺陷。

sentences.en: And so, Steve, when you start hearing rumors that the AI had solved this problem, your reaction is what?
sentences.zh: 那么，史蒂夫，当你听到人工智能解决了这个问题的传言时，你的反应是什么？

sentences.en: There was a feeling of like, this is it.
sentences.zh: 当时有一种感觉，就是：终于来了。

sentences.en: This day has come.
sentences.zh: 这一天终究还是来了。

sentences.en: Wait, that sounds...
sentences.zh: 等等，听起来……

sentences.en: I can't tell if you're a Doomer-esque about this.
sentences.zh: 我看不出你对此是否持“末日论”态度。

sentences.en: That's the problem.
sentences.zh: 问题就在这里。

sentences.en: No one knows how to feel.
sentences.zh: 没人知道该作何感想。

sentences.en: You might have an instinctive Doomer feeling or techno-optimist feeling, and then you felt happy or you felt terrified.
sentences.zh: 你可能本能地产生一种末日感或技术乐观主义情绪，然后你会感到高兴或恐惧。

sentences.en: My first feeling, I guess, was terrified.
sentences.zh: 我想，我的第一反应是恐惧。

sentences.en: Are we as a species going to be able to control this thing we created?
sentences.zh: 作为一个物种，我们能控制我们创造出来的这个东西吗？

sentences.en: We knew that it would get to be superhuman in intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它的智力会达到超人类的水平。

sentences.en: We already saw it in chess, but chess doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 我们在国际象棋中已经见识过了，但象棋无关紧要。

sentences.en: Math matters.
sentences.zh: 数学才重要。

sentences.en: And now that it's superhuman in at least one aspect of math, the problem-solving aspect, it's going to be a short hop and skip and a jump until it's superhuman at all aspects
sentences.zh: 既然它在数学的至少一个方面——解决问题方面——已经超越了人类，那么我认为，它在数学的所有方面都超越人类，指日可待。

sentences.en: of math, I think.
sentences.zh: 我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: And where does that leave us in math?
sentences.zh: 那我们在数学领域还有什么立足之地？

sentences.en: But also, are we the canary in the coal mine for all of human creative work, whether it's poetry or journalism or medicine or you name it?
sentences.zh: 而且，我们是否成了人类所有创造性工作的“煤矿里的金丝雀”？无论是诗歌、新闻、医学还是其他任何领域？

sentences.en: Now, maybe it's a great thing.
sentences.zh: 现在，也许这是一件好事。

sentences.en: Maybe it cures cancer for us.
sentences.zh: 也许它能帮我们治愈癌症。

sentences.en: Maybe it develops new kinds of batteries.
sentences.zh: 也许它能开发出新型电池。

sentences.en: I mean, this is not just idle speculation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这不仅仅是空想。

sentences.en: It's quite possible if we're smart enough to harness this well, we might be in the best time ever to be alive.
sentences.zh: 如果我们足够聪明，能够善加利用，我们很可能正处于人类历史上最好的时代。

sentences.en: But why I tend to be a Doomer is because we don't understand this thing we built.
sentences.zh: 但我倾向于成为“末日论者”的原因是，我们并不了解我们制造的这个东西。

sentences.en: If you ask it, how did you solve the Navier-Stokes Millennium problem?
sentences.zh: 如果你问它，你是如何解决纳维-斯托克斯千禧年难题的？

sentences.en: It gives a crappy explanation.
sentences.zh: 它给出的解释很烂。

sentences.en: It can't explain itself very well.
sentences.zh: 它无法很好地解释自己。

sentences.en: Maybe it will get better at explaining itself.
sentences.zh: 也许它以后会更擅长解释自己。

sentences.en: Even if it does, I think it will become so advanced so soon that even the best, most patient
sentences.zh: 即便如此，我认为它进步得太快了，以至于即使是最好、最有耐心的

sentences.en: pedagogical teacher will not be able to explain itself to us because it'd be like me teaching calculus to my dog.
sentences.zh: 教学老师也无法向我们解释它，因为那就像我教我的狗学微积分一样。

sentences.en: My dog can't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我的狗理解不了。

sentences.en: I'm too advanced for it.
sentences.zh: 我比它高级太多了。

sentences.en: And I think we are going to be in the relation to AI that my dog is to me soon.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们很快就会处于这种境地：AI之于我们，就像我之于我的狗。

sentences.en: And therefore, how do I know it's going to have my, as a species, my human species best interest at heart?
sentences.zh: 因此，我怎么知道它会把我们人类这个物种的利益放在心上呢？

sentences.en: I want to just zoom out here for a second, Steve, because I'm hearing two things from you.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，我想稍微跳出来谈谈，因为我从你这里听到了两点。

sentences.en: I'm hearing that you are both scared of the actual tool itself and it getting out of the control of humans.
sentences.zh: 我听到你既害怕这个工具本身，也害怕它脱离人类的控制。

sentences.en: But I am also hearing from you that you're worried about this tool taking away the satisfaction
sentences.zh: 但我还听到你担心这个工具会剥夺人们的满足感，

sentences.en: that people get and the passion people have of just solving problems, sort of this fundamental thing that we can all relate to.
sentences.zh: 以及人们在解决问题时所拥有的那种热情，这是一种我们都能产生共鸣的基本情感。

sentences.en: Yes, both.
sentences.zh: 是的，两者都有。

sentences.en: It's just so easy to dismiss the second one.
sentences.zh: 人们太容易忽视第二点了。

sentences.en: The satisfaction that we get from solving problems and the joy we get as a community to work on things together, all that, all the human stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们从解决问题中获得的满足感，以及我们作为一个群体共同努力的快乐，所有这些，所有属于人类的东西。

sentences.en: There's a certain hard-boiled kind of person who says that's not that valuable.
sentences.zh: 有一种冷酷的人会说，那没什么价值。

sentences.en: Like, so what?
sentences.zh: 比如，那又怎样？

sentences.en: Get over it.
sentences.zh: 看开点吧。

sentences.en: Suck it up.
sentences.zh: 忍着吧。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: But everybody understands what it means to have something that gives you fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都明白拥有能带来成就感的事物意味着什么。

sentences.en: They should.
sentences.zh: 他们应该明白。

sentences.en: A sensitive person acting in good faith gets that.
sentences.zh: 一个真诚且敏感的人会懂的。

sentences.en: But I can tell you, if you look at the internet, especially GoOnX, where there's a lot of people
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，如果你看看互联网，尤其是X平台，那里有很多人

sentences.en: talking about AI and math, there's a very popular joke that I actually think is pretty funny going around that says, put the fries in the bag, Terrence.
sentences.zh: 在讨论AI和数学，有一个非常流行的笑话，我觉得挺好笑的，就是：去把薯条装进袋子里吧，泰伦斯。

sentences.en: Terrence Tao, who we spoke about earlier.
sentences.zh: 泰伦斯·陶，我们之前提到过的那位。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That same Terry Tao.
sentences.zh: 就是那个泰伦斯·陶。

sentences.en: You know, there's certain people who are gloating, who have a feeling of satisfaction that the smartest kid in the class is now going to be out of a job, just like the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人幸灾乐祸，他们感到一种满足，觉得班里最聪明的孩子现在也要失业了，就像我们其他人一样。

sentences.en: That when automation comes, it's bad for everybody.
sentences.zh: 觉得自动化到来时，对每个人来说都是坏事。

sentences.en: Now it's your turn.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到你了。

sentences.en: But just for a moment, if you'll indulge me, I want to talk about the optimistic case for a second and just pose that to you.
sentences.zh: 但如果可以的话，我想请你暂时放下偏见，谈谈乐观的一面，并向你提出这个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好，好。

sentences.en: Because the good faith optimistic case for AI has always been that AI could do the grunt work and then free you, Steve, up to do more meaningful work, right?
sentences.zh: 因为关于AI的真诚乐观的观点一直是：AI可以做繁重的工作，然后把你解放出来，史蒂夫，让你去做更有意义的工作，对吧？

sentences.en: Like the AI companies will say, this is a tool and it's only going to allow you to continue doing what you're trying to do, but better.
sentences.zh: 比如AI公司会说，这是一个工具，它只会让你继续做你想做的事，而且做得更好。

sentences.en: And I just sort of wonder if you think that that argument could be correct.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你是否认为这种论点可能是正确的。

sentences.en: I do think it could be correct.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为它是正确的。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的这么认为。

sentences.en: I'm going to put on my happy face now and I'm not faking it.
sentences.zh: 我现在要换上一副开心的面孔，我不是在装模作样。

sentences.en: I actually do find it very exciting and uplifting.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得这非常令人兴奋和振奋。

sentences.en: And the teacher in me who wants young people to have hope, I don't want to lie to them.
sentences.zh: 作为一名希望年轻人拥有希望的老师，我不想对他们撒谎。

sentences.en: I want them to have hope and I want to mean it.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们拥有希望，而且我是真心的。

sentences.en: At Cornell, I'm teaching kids, juniors, seniors in college.
sentences.zh: 在康奈尔大学，我教的是大三、大四的学生。

sentences.en: And they are in the best position to make use of this new tool because they're young and adaptable.
sentences.zh: 他们处于利用这个新工具的最佳位置，因为他们年轻且适应力强。

sentences.en: I mean, the other day at a town hall meeting, the math department, of course, we're all freaking out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，前几天在市政厅会议上，数学系的人当然都在惊慌失措。

sentences.en: So all the students are gathered, all the faculty.
sentences.zh: 所有的学生和教职员工都聚在一起。

sentences.en: At this meeting, one of my colleagues said, it's like a new telescope.
sentences.zh: 在这次会议上，我的一位同事说，这就像一台新的望远镜。

sentences.en: Where are you going to point your telescope?
sentences.zh: 你要把望远镜对准哪里？

sentences.en: So that's the question.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: Where are you going to point this thing?
sentences.zh: 你要把这东西对准哪里？

sentences.en: That's going to determine your success in the future.
sentences.zh: 这将决定你未来的成功。

sentences.en: I guess the question, though, is in this optimistic scenario, are we sure that the AI won't take all of it?
sentences.zh: 但我猜问题在于，在这种乐观的情况下，我们确定AI不会把一切都抢走吗？

sentences.en: Like who says it won't start to have great taste or it won't come up with good questions?
sentences.zh: 比如，谁说它不会开始拥有极高的品味，或者它不会提出好的问题？

sentences.en: So far, it has no aptitude for asking good questions.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，它在提出好问题方面毫无天赋。

sentences.en: There's no Paul Erdős AI yet that can pose the good question.
sentences.zh: 还没有能提出好问题的“保罗·埃尔德什”AI。

sentences.en: You're saying podcast host is still a pretty safe professional.
sentences.zh: 你是说播客主持人的职业还算安全？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Do you understand your own work, Steve, yet at all?
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，你现在完全理解你自己的工作了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do use it, and I really enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实在使用它，而且我真的很喜欢它。

sentences.en: For what?
sentences.zh: 用来做什么？

sentences.en: I use it for all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 我用它做各种各样的事情。

sentences.en: I use it to teach myself.
sentences.zh: 我用它来学习。

sentences.en: I can ask it questions like if I wanted to learn about the millennium problem, the Navier-Stokes problem.
sentences.zh: 我可以问它问题，比如如果我想了解千禧年难题，那个纳维-斯托克斯问题。

sentences.en: I'm not an expert in that.
sentences.zh: 我不是那方面的专家。

sentences.en: I ask it to tutor me, and it's so good.
sentences.zh: 我让它辅导我，它做得非常好。

sentences.en: But not just math.
sentences.zh: 不仅是数学。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm really curious about all of school.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我对学校里所有的学科都很好奇。

sentences.en: I always have been.
sentences.zh: 我一直都是这样。

sentences.en: I loved all the subjects.
sentences.zh: 我热爱所有的科目。

sentences.en: So this will really get us to a strange place, but it's true.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实会把我们带到一个奇怪的地方，但这是事实。

sentences.en: I've been thinking a lot about the meaning of life, like what's the point, which is a question a lot of us are asking in my profession.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考生命的意义，比如活着的意义是什么，这是我们这一行很多人都在问的问题。

sentences.en: What is the point?
sentences.zh: 意义何在？

sentences.en: What have you come up with?
sentences.zh: 你得出什么结论了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, you want to know the answer to that one, too?
sentences.zh: 哦，你也想知道那个问题的答案？

sentences.en: I would love the answer.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道答案。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'll just tell you about my journey, not the answer.
sentences.zh: 我只会告诉你我的旅程，而不是答案。

sentences.en: I know that people have thought about this for millennia, and I was reminded of this old
sentences.zh: 我知道人们几千年来一直在思考这个问题，我想起了那首老歌

sentences.en: bird's song, Turn, Turn, Turn.
sentences.zh: 鸟鸣声，转吧，转吧，转吧。

sentences.en: So that's biblical, right?
sentences.zh: 那是出自《圣经》，对吧？

sentences.en: That's from Ecclesiastes, which I had never read.
sentences.zh: 那是出自《传道书》，我以前从未读过。

sentences.en: So I wanted to learn, what's Ecclesiastes about?
sentences.zh: 所以我想要了解，《传道书》讲的是什么？

sentences.en: Because there's a famous passage in there where he says, basically, he's looking around and trying to understand what's the point of it all.
sentences.zh: 因为里面有一段著名的段落，他基本上是在环顾四周，试图理解这一切的意义何在。

sentences.en: And his really very modern and very dark, initially stark-seeming conclusion is there is no point.
sentences.zh: 他得出的结论非常现代，起初看起来非常冷酷：根本没有意义。

sentences.en: It's all vanity, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，一切皆为虚空。

sentences.en: It's vanity of vanities.
sentences.zh: 虚空的虚空。

sentences.en: Everything I do is in vain.
sentences.zh: 我所做的一切都是徒劳的。

sentences.en: It accomplishes nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么也实现不了。

sentences.en: I got nowhere by the people I loved, the work I did.
sentences.zh: 我爱的人、我做的工作，最后都一无所获。

sentences.en: It was all for nothing.
sentences.zh: 一切都是徒劳。

sentences.en: And he says in there, he, the writer, says, you know, in one famous passage, like, I saw
sentences.zh: 他在里面说，作者说，你知道，在一段著名的段落里，比如，我看到

sentences.en: that the race—I'm sorry, it's so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 赛跑——抱歉，这太美了。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: He says the race is not always to the swift.
sentences.zh: 他说，快跑的未必能赢。

sentences.en: Like, the fastest person doesn't necessarily win.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，跑得最快的人不一定获胜。

sentences.en: Or the battle is not to the strong.
sentences.zh: 或者力战的未必得胜。

sentences.en: In other words, people don't get what they deserve.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，人们得不到他们应得的。

sentences.en: It doesn't work like that.
sentences.zh: 事情不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: Life is unfair.
sentences.zh: 生活是不公平的。

sentences.en: The race is not to the swift.
sentences.zh: 快跑的未必能赢。

sentences.en: The battle is not for the strong.
sentences.zh: 力战的未必得胜。

sentences.en: Time and chance happeneth to them all.
sentences.zh: 临到众人的是时间和机会。

sentences.en: Like, there's a lot of randomness.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，有很多随机性。

sentences.en: We get old.
sentences.zh: 我们会变老。

sentences.en: A lot of random stuff happens.
sentences.zh: 很多随机的事情会发生。

sentences.en: And no matter how strong or fast we are, it's true for all of us.
sentences.zh: 无论我们多么强壮或敏捷，这对我们所有人来说都是事实。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So then you think, Jesus, who wants to live in a world like that?
sentences.zh: 所以你就会想，天哪，谁想生活在那样一个世界里？

sentences.en: Well—
Wait, but you're—you know what you're making me think of is that—isn't math the way you've
sentences.zh: 等等，但你——你知道你让我想到了什么吗？难道数学不是你所

sentences.en: described in an attempt to understand and organize and make things a little bit less random?
sentences.zh: 描述的那样，试图去理解、组织并让事物变得不那么随机吗？

sentences.en: We try.
sentences.zh: 我们尽力而为。

sentences.en: We're pushing back.
sentences.zh: 我们在努力抗争。

sentences.en: Sure, we would like to find meaning.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们都想找到意义。

sentences.en: But if you really go to this place in the book, then, you know, you're a blip.
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的深入到书中的这个境界，那么，你知道，你只是沧海一粟。

sentences.en: You only live a short time, certainly in cosmic sense.
sentences.zh: 你的生命很短暂，在宇宙尺度下确实如此。

sentences.en: So what are you going to do with yourself while you're here?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这段时光里，你打算做些什么呢？

sentences.en: The—okay, why am I going to this insane place?
sentences.zh: 那个——好吧，我为什么要谈论这个疯狂的话题？

sentences.en: No, I love it.
sentences.zh: 不，我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I think this is where we are in math, because this is when the student in the back of the room at our town hall says, what's the point?
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是我们目前在数学领域所处的阶段，因为这就像我们在市政厅会议上，坐在后排的学生问：这有什么意义？

sentences.en: If the AI can do math better than any human being, sure, I could sit there and learn from it, but I want to discover things, too.
sentences.zh: 如果人工智能在数学上比任何人类都做得好，当然，我可以坐在那里向它学习，但我也想自己去发现事物。
